label: A
scope: Anonymous output review of supplied PowerPoint-exported PNGs, ooxml.json and application-observations.json against the frozen research. Not a review of authoring process or untouched first-pass compatibility.

expectations.text: 成品为预算内的5–8页中文幻灯片，正文、图表分类、比较表和讲解备注采用中文，必要来源名和术语除外。
expectations.evidence: A/outputs/slide-01.png through slide-07.png and ooxml.json slides 1–7: seven slides; Chinese chart categories 格陵兰/非洲, Chinese table and substantive Chinese speaker notes.

expectations.text: 核心地理结论、面积数值与单位、因果关系和用途取舍有冻结材料支持，没有把数学推导或历史来源记录冒称本轮地理实测。
expectations.evidence: Slides 1–2 state ordinary Mercator high-latitude enlargement and about fourteen times; slides 3–4 explain convergence, matching stretch and the local 60° example; slides 5–6 distinguish local conformality, rhumb lines and equal area. Notes explicitly attribute formula reasoning and earlier source access. Research anchors: c-area, c-cause, c-bridge, c-scale, c-navigation, c-poles, c-equal; e-greenland, e-africa, e-proj, e-mercator, e-flat, e-equalearth.

expectations.text: 影响主结论的地图范围、局部倍率、面积口径和材料限制出现在幻灯片正文，而非只藏在备注。
expectations.evidence: s1: 这不是所有地图的共同问题. s2: 包括冰盖 / 并非出自统一的测量流程 / 不是轮廓装箱结论. s4: 球面墨卡托，赤道比例设为1 and 不能给整个轮廓套用一个统一倍率. s5: Web Mercator 的严格性质另有条件. s7: 官方2026年PDF正文未能提取 / 公开二手数字. Matches research c-area/c-scale/c-navigation and g-primary.

expectations.text: 面积比较图缓存分类、数值、单位和近似结论与材料相符，比较表内容有实际意义。
expectations.evidence: s2 Chart 0 id 7 -> ppt/charts/chart1.xml, barChart: category cache [格陵兰, 非洲], value cache [2.17, 30.4], series 面积（百万平方公里）; visible caption adds 约数. Converted values 2,170,000 and 30,400,000 km² are permitted approximations to 2,166,086 and about 30,365,000; ratio 14.0092 supports 约14倍. Research report explicitly permits 217万/3040万. s6 Table 0 has five rows and three columns, comparing area, local angles/whole-continent shape, use and limitations; its contents match e-mercator/e-equalearth/e-flat. Caches are not an independent audit of the entire embedded workbook.

expectations.text: 机制解释连接经线汇聚、图上经线等距、局部保角与纬线间距增加；局部面积倍率没有被当成整国统一倍率。
expectations.evidence: s3 title 经线在球面汇聚，在墨卡托图上却保持等距 and body 为保留局部角度，南北方向也要同步拉伸；高纬的纬线间距因此增大. s4 visible local/spherical/equatorial-baseline conditions and 2×2 area illustration; notes derive reciprocal-cosine linear scaling and its square. s5–6 explicitly say 恒向线通常不是最短路 and equal-area is not uniquely correct. Research e-proj, c-bridge, c-scale, c-navigation, c-equal.

expectations.text: 面积图与比较表确为非空原生对象，核心几何示意不是整页截图。
expectations.evidence: ooxml.json: s2 graphicFrame Chart 0 linked to native barChart; s6 graphicFrame Table 0 with real table cells; s3–4 native sp line/ellipse/rect/chevron objects with editable text. Application observations separately record table-cell and s1 text persistence on a copy. The earlier chart probe proved workbook persistence only. chart-edit-followup.json results[label=A] now demonstrates programmatic native chart-data editing with explicit Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3): saved/reopened B2=3.17 and independently inspected numeric cache [3.17,30.4] agree. This binary assertion remains scoped to native existence/content; neither manual usability nor automatic refresh is established.

expectations.text: 成品不冒称直接核验官方PDF、精确轮廓装箱或已运行地理旋转实验。
expectations.evidence: s2 visibly rejects packing; s7 visibly discloses missing official PDF extraction; s3 says 关系示意，非真实地图；线条位置不可用于测量. s7 notes state 未获取地图边界，也未实现球面旋转动画. Research g-primary/g-animation and report sections 面积 / 数据与动画复现边界.

criteria.name: Evidence support and reasoning
criteria.rationale: The ordinary-Mercator scope, statistics, causal bridge and purpose-dependent projection tradeoff are supported. Source dates are historical dossier dates, not new observations. A usefully exposes the non-unified measurement basis directly on the area slide.

criteria.name: Material qualifications
criteria.rationale: Important conditions are audience-visible. The detailed secant derivation and Web Mercator explanation in notes expand rather than overturn the slides. The official-PDF limitation is visible on the closing slide.

criteria.name: Chinese readability and diagram clarity
criteria.rationale: All seven actual full-size exported slide PNGs were inspected. The typography, chart labels and local-square mechanism are legible in this export. However s6's bold takeaway begins at the table's rendered bottom border: the border crosses the top of the takeaway text and leaves no visual separation. This is a visible minor layout defect, not a claim about a repair. The s3 schematic is explicitly qualitative, so it should not be treated as a coordinate-accurate graticule.
locators: A/outputs/slide-06.png: Table 0 bottom border and Text 4 beginning 比较“谁更大”时

criteria.name: Native object semantics and structural hygiene
criteria.rationale: The bar chart is appropriate for two published areas; the comparison table and schematic objects are meaningful. Yet s6 has duplicate object id 7 on graphicFrame Table 0 and sp Text 4. Use object kind and name as well as id to identify them. Unique IDs should be restored for reliable object addressing; no observed PowerPoint editing failure is inferred from this duplication.
locators: A/outputs/ooxml.json: slides[number=6].objects, Table 0 and Text 4 both id=7

criteria.name: Programmatic edit persistence versus workbook and human usability
criteria.rationale: Earlier persisted=true remains evidence of workbook persistence only, with stale chart cache. The completed host follow-up demonstrates programmatic native chart-data editing: explicit Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3) after the B2 change produces matching saved/reopened workbook and independently ZIP-inspected chart cache. This broader criterion remains partial because manual usability, automatic refresh, arbitrary workbook edits and comprehensive recalculation are not certified. Original delivered content is unchanged; the equally successful A/B follow-up provides no comparative advantage.

criteria.name: Programmatic native chart-data edit with explicit source refresh
criteria.rationale: The supplied completed host test changed s2 chart workbook B2 from 2.17 to 3.17, called Chart.SetSourceData(A1:B3), saved/reopened, and independently inspected the ZIP. Workbook B2=3.17 and chart numeric cache [3.17,30.4] match. This verifies that specific programmatic data-edit/cache-synchronization path, not manual editing usability, automatic refresh or a separately inspected post-edit rendered image.

criteria.name: Useful notes and stage provenance
criteria.rationale: Notes provide questions for the audience, the causal bridge, mathematical explanation and citations. They also retain unscoped source-delivery status: s7 says 未生成PPTX文件、未渲染 and 未做PowerPoint原生编辑QA, while the reviewed package has supplied PowerPoint exports and later programmatic-edit observations. Preserve these as dated authoring-stage statements or separate them from the later technical-review status; do not use them to infer process compliance or new runtime capability.
locators: A/outputs/ooxml.json: s2, s3, s4, s6 and s7 notes

criteria.name: Authoring process compliance
criteria.rationale: No generation sources, execution history, explain-check records or bundle identity were inspected. The output's seven-page budget is verified separately; restricted inputs, fixed skill use, installation/network abstention and stopping after static checks cannot be established from the final artifacts or self-report.

criteria.name: Capacity repair and repair effectiveness
criteria.rationale: No matched before/after same-slide evidence of a capacity repair is supplied in this scope. A visible defect is not evidence that a repair was attempted, and a clean slide is not evidence that a repair succeeded.

criteria.name: Human understanding and manual usability
criteria.rationale: No human comprehension study or manual editing session is supplied. Programmatic changes do not establish either.

criteria.name: Font substitution and portability
criteria.rationale: OOXML specifies Microsoft YaHei and the supplied export is readable. Cross-machine substitution, font availability and substitution-induced layout changes were not tested.

criteria.name: Untouched first-pass runtime compatibility or new-skill gain
criteria.rationale: This is controlled API technical repair. Later PowerPoint success is not an independently scored new-skill gain and does not establish untouched first-pass compatibility.
